selection_policy: Rank and any production-candidate recommendation use training-fold CV F1. Held-out test metrics are reported once for final retrospective evaluation, not used to choose the model.

completed.model_notes: Linear SVM is used for the full 253,680-row BRFSS benchmark. The previously registered RBF SVC has quadratic scaling and is not a production-safe full-data implementation. Probabilities are calibrated on the validation partition.
Histogram implementation preserves full-data training with practical runtime.
